name: comment_add
description: Add a comment as Acrobat's commenting tools do. Geometry is in points with the origin at the top-left of the displayed page, y down (as in page_render images at 72 dpi and text_find rects). note: `at` [x, y] (icon top-left). stamp: `at` [x, y] (its centre) and `stamp`: approved, completed, confidential, draft, final, for comment, for public release, information only, not approved, not for public release, preliminary results, void, accepted, initial here, rejected, sign here, witness; dynamic: true for the dynamic approved/confidential/received/reviewed/revised stamps with a By … at … line. highlight/underline/strikeout/squiggly: `find` (text on the page to mark; every match with all: true) or `quads`. rectangle/oval/textbox: `rect` [x0, y0, x1, y1]. line/arrow: `from`, `to`. ink: `strokes` [[[x, y], …], …]. polygon/cloud/polyline (connected lines): `points` [[x, y], …]. callout: `rect` (its text box), `to` (the point the arrow touches), optional `knee`. caret (inserted text): `at`, the insertion point on the baseline. replace (Replace Text): `find` or `quads` like highlight, `contents` the replacement. attachment: `path` (the file), `at`, optional `icon` (PushPin, Paperclip, Graph, Tag). Undoable.

all.description: Mark every match of `find` on the page, not just the first.

at.description: [x, y] in points from the top-left of the displayed page.

color.description: #RRGGBB or a name: yellow, red, orange, green, blue, purple, pink, black, gray, white.

contents.description: The comment text (what a text box shows).

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

fill.description: #RRGGBB or a name: yellow, red, orange, green, blue, purple, pink, black, gray, white.

find.description: Text on the page to mark up (case-insensitive).

from.description: [x, y] in points from the top-left of the displayed page.

icon.description: note: Comment, Note, Help, Insert, Key, NewParagraph, Paragraph; attachment: PushPin, Paperclip, Graph, Tag.

knee.description: [x, y] in points from the top-left of the displayed page.

items.description: [x, y] in points from the top-left of the displayed page.
[x, y] in points from the top-left of the displayed page.

to.description: [x, y] in points from the top-left of the displayed page.
